title: Chita: A Memory of Last Island
sourceTitle: Chita: A Memory of Last Island
author: Lafcadio Hearn
description: "Chita: A Memory of Last Island" by Lafcadio Hearn is a novel written during the late 19th century.
longDescription: The story unfolds on the Louisiana coast, specifically at Last Island, touching upon themes of nature's power and human folly against the backdrop of a catastrophic storm that strikes during a festive gathering. The opening of the book describes the lush and haunting beauty of the Louisiana bayous and the islands along the Gulf, setting a vivid scene of the coastal landscape.

authorInfo.bio: Patrick Lafcadio Hearn was a Greek and Irish writer, translator, and teacher whose work played a significant role in the introduction of the culture and literature of Japan to the mainstream Western world.
